nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding token decimals
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply
Mapping 'balances' from address to uint holding token balances
Nested mapping 'allowed' address=>address=>uint holding ERC20 allowances
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, total supply and minting all tokens to msg.sender
View function totalSupply() returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
View function balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returning balances[tokenOwner]
View function allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits msg.sender balance, credits 'to' using SafeMath and emits Transfer
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves balances and decrements allowance using SafeMath
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) with overflow require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) with underflow require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) with require(b > 0)
msg.sender, externally controlled caller address used to key balances and allowances
Arithmetic on balances in transfer() via safeSub/safeAdd, guarded by SafeMath requires
Arithmetic on balances and allowed in transferFrom() via safeSub/safeAdd, guarded by SafeMath requires
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner)
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender)
Parameter spender of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender)
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens)
Parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b)
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b)
Local return variable c of SafeMath.safeAdd holding the addition result

edges.reason: constructor derives the initial token recipient and balance owner directly from msg.sender
approve keys the allowed mapping with msg.sender, making the caller the allowance owner
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender], so caller identity controls the source balance
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so caller identity controls the allowance consumed
spender parameter is the key written into the allowed mapping by approve
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve
to parameter is the credit destination of the transfer
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer
from parameter is the balance source debited by transferFrom
to parameter is the balance destination credited by transferFrom
tokens parameter is the amount debited, credited and deducted from allowance
tokenOwner parameter selects the balances entry returned by balanceOf
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance
parameter a of safeAdd is an operand of the guarded addition
parameter b of safeAdd is an operand of the guarded addition
local c in safeAdd receives the result of the addition checked against overflow
constructor assigns the token name state variable
constructor assigns the token symbol state variable
constructor assigns the decimals state variable
constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply
constructor mints the entire supply into balances[msg.sender]
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and receiver
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the reported supply
transfer delegates its subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub
transfer delegates its addition to SafeMath.safeAdd
transferFrom delegates its subtractions to SafeMath.safeSub
transferFrom delegates its addition to SafeMath.safeAdd
transfer performs balance addition and subtraction that would be arithmetically unsafe without the SafeMath guards
transferFrom performs balance and allowance subtraction and addition that would be arithmetically unsafe without the SafeMath guards
balances mapping values flow into the subtraction and addition of transfer, the location of potential overflow or underflow
allowed mapping values flow into the allowance subtraction of transferFrom, the location of potential underflow
